import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = 2*np.pi/20
    return (params[0] + params[1]*np.cos(w*t) + params[2]*np.sin(w*t) + params[3]*x
            + params[4]*x*x + params[5]*v + params[6]*v*v + params[7]*v*np.exp(-x)
            + params[8]*x*np.exp(-v) + params[9]*np.sqrt(x))
